$comment: Sefaria import manifest (ADR-010, ADR-012). Run: npm run content:import. Units are ordered by this list (Siddur within each section; study units within each type, which is the daily rotation order). Ids are stable: never rename one (progress references it). Mesillat Yesharim ranges were split at ~800 Hebrew characters.
